review_lane: independent native evidence and readiness observer review
subject: EXT-F-2013-T10 guest Chat opening, same-conversation follow-up, and post-reload new conversation on v0.2.543

verdict_A_guest_evidence.basis: The fresh signed-out guest completed the opening request, same-conversation follow-up, and post-reload new conversation. The structured native receipt reports terminal answers, fixture-specific grounding, ordered opening stages, and stable conversation identity. All three screenshots show real side-panel answer text, but only portions of each answer are visible; terminality and full grounding therefore rely on the structured receipt rather than a complete visible answer in a screenshot.
verdict_A_guest_evidence.resource_verdict: Package, browser, and guest resource journals each ended with decision=valid, admitted=true, resourceInvalid=false, and exitCode=0.
verdict_A_guest_evidence.resource_observation: The guest journal recorded a CPU_PENDING sample at 0.96 busy fraction, followed by recovery and a valid final decision.
verdict_A_guest_evidence.scope: Three observed signed-out guest sends only; no signed-in behavior or broader Chat health is established.

verdict_B_readiness_observer.basis: The reviewed observer distinguishes an exact ready Send button from the package initialization shell, exposes bounded counts/booleans and an allowlisted label, and does not forward arbitrary label or ARIA strings. Its timeline bounds samples and strips arbitrary attributes. The driver waits only for state?.sendEnabled, so missing or error observations cannot satisfy the wait; native click execution follows only after readiness. Timeout diagnostics use the bounded timeline. No bypass around the readiness gate was found.
verdict_B_readiness_observer.reviewer_reported_red_green: The initialization-shell test failed as expected against the pre-commit package-chat-controls.mjs, then the committed focused suite passed 13/13 tests.

evidence_limits: Screenshots show portions of each real answer; the structured native receipt establishes the terminal and grounding predicates.
The hosted workflow startup diagnostic step was skipped; that diagnostic remains unverified.
The guest run used isolated native key adaptation and does not establish a live Chrome Web Store installation lifecycle or private Store status.
credential_handling: No credentials, tokens, or raw assistant transcript were retained in this report.
review_method: Fresh independent review of hosted guest evidence and the exact readiness observer commit; the reviewer report was sanitized into this record.
